verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents core dunning capability — automated email reminders and smart retry scheduling based on gateway decline types (docs-11, docs-12), and webhook evidence shows a final-state outcome (subscription_cancelled due to non-payment, docs-21). However, there's no evidence of branded/customizable email templates, in-app banners, or configurable grace-period settings, and no explicit dunning end-state rule distinguishing cancel vs. marking a subscription unpaid. missing for 10: branded email template customization, in-app banner notifications, explicit grace-period configuration, and documented cancel-vs-unpaid end-state rule settings.
